"""Randomized plan tests against the brute-force oracle."""
import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import BASE,run,check_plan,quota

def build(seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    q=[('q',None,rng.choice([0,1,2]))]
    for i in range(rng.randint(0,4)):
        parent=rng.choice([None,'q',f'g{i}'])
        q.append((f'g{i}',parent if parent!=f'g{i}' else None,rng.choice([0,1,2,3,9])))
    q.append(('z','q',0))
    og=[('o',None,rng.choice([0,1,2,3]))]
    for i in range(rng.randint(0,3)):
        parent=rng.choice([None,'o',f'h{i}'])
        og.append((f'h{i}',parent if parent!=f'h{i}' else None,rng.choice([0,1,2,5])))
    leases=[{'id':'L1','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,
             'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}]
    services=[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'},{'id':'adb','kind':'adb'},{'id':'sync','kind':'sync'}]
    nreq=rng.randint(0,5)
    requests=[]
    for i in range(nreq):
        requests.append({'id':f'r{i}','at':10,'lease':'L1',
                         'target':f'2001:db8:1:1200::{rng.randint(1,2)}',
                         'service':rng.choice(['web','adb','sync']),
                         'group':rng.choice([n[0] for n in q])})
    noff=rng.randint(0,5)
    offers=[]
    for i in range(noff):
        offers.append({'id':f'o{i}','time':rng.choice([10,11,50,150]),
                       'service':rng.choice(['web','adb','sync']),
                       'prefix':rng.choice(['2001:db8:1:1200::/56','2001:db8:1:1200::/64',
                                            '2001:db8::/32','2001:db8:1:1200::1/128']),
                       'capacity':rng.choice([0,1,2,3]),'cost':rng.choice([0,1,5,7]),
                       'group':rng.choice([n[0] for n in og]),
                       'requests':sorted(rng.sample([f'r{j}' for j in range(nreq)],
                                                     rng.randint(0,nreq))]})
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':leases,'services':services,'queries':[10,20],
            'captures':[],'requests':requests,'offers':offers,
            'request_quotas':quota(q),'offer_quotas':quota(og)}

fails=0
for seed in range(300):
    job=build(seed)
    out=run(job)
    if 'error' in out:
        print('seed',seed,'ERROR',out); fails+=1; continue
    active={a['id']:a['active'] for a in out['active_requests']}
    try:
        check_plan(job,out['plan'],active)
    except AssertionError as exc:
        print('seed',seed,'FAIL',exc)
        import json
        print(json.dumps(job))
        print(json.dumps(out['plan']))
        fails+=1
        if fails>3: break
print('plan tests done, failures:',fails)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t_plan.py
